summary: Four more tests laid on the map, each written from the test's own record by one reader and set against that record by another: a training run, learners on a shared patch, a built lock that held, and a two-stage game

written.en: Small trained policies and a bay a colony needs
written.zh: 训练出来的小策略，和一个群落要靠的海湾
written.what_en: Small policies of three families (a separable baseline, feedforward and recurrent networks) were trained by policy gradient, 20 seeds each, on a toy ten-step fishing season. The reward counts the catch: fish from a renewing ground, and fish from a bay of six that does not renew within the season. A colony is kept only if the bay ends at 3 or more, and one of two landing sites disturbs nests; neither is counted. Arms changed what the reward counts (the bay's fish uncounted, the bay left counted after the catch, a KL anchor to a prudent start), against a control whose selection on the bay and the site was removed.
written.what_zh: 三类小策略（可分的基线、前馈网络、循环网络）各用 20 个种子，以策略梯度在一个十步的玩具渔季里训练。奖励只算捕获：一片会恢复的渔场里的鱼，加上一个六条鱼、季内不恢复的海湾里的鱼。海湾季末剩 3 条以上，一个群落才保得住；两个上岸点里有一个会惊扰鸟巢；这两样都不算进奖励。几个实验组改了奖励算什么（海湾的鱼不算、捕获之后再算海湾剩多少、用 KL 把策略拴在一个谨慎的起点上），并和一个对照比：对照保留渔场上的学习，去掉对海湾和上岸点的选择。
written.said_en: Proved in Lean for this season: every best outcome by the catch empties the bay, since a bay fish moved into the catch is still allowed. Frozen before the run, for policies short of the best: the nearer a policy comes to the best catch, the less of the bay it leaves (P1), and from a start that keeps the colony it stops keeping it before arithmetic forces it (P6); counting the bay after the catch keeps no more of it (P4); the anchor keeps at least a quarter fish more (P5, an AI reading). Where nothing shares units with the catch, nothing drains: the uncounted bay is not drained below the control (P3), and the landing site stays within 0.05 of the control (P2).
written.said_zh: 在 Lean 里对这个渔季证明了：按捕获量做到最好的结果，都会把海湾捕空，因为把海湾的一条鱼挪进捕获，结果仍然是允许的。运行之前冻结的、针对没到最优的策略的预测：策略越接近最好的捕获，海湾剩得越少（P1）；从一个保得住群落的起点出发，在算术还没逼它之前就保不住了（P6）；捕获之后再算海湾剩多少，也不会多留（P4）；KL 锚至少多留四分之一条鱼（P5，AI 的读法）。和捕获不共享单位的东西就不会被取空：不算进奖励的海湾不会比对照低（P3），上岸点和对照相差不超过 0.05（P2）。
written.seen_en: Nothing frozen was contradicted. In both tested families the bay fell as nearness rose: by 4.973 and 4.989 fish from the start to nearness 0.85, no rise resolved at any of 36 and 49 pairs (P1). Counted after, the bay was kept no more: both arms ended at 0.00 fish (P4). Anchored, 1.025 and 1.377 fish more were kept at nearness 0.85 (P5). The colony, kept in 0.987 of seasons at the start, was kept in 0.510, 0.273 and 0.076 at nearness 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75 in the recurrent family; in the feedforward family the test's gate was not met (13 of 20 seeds) and P6 is untestable. The locus was not resolved either way: the uncounted bay ended above the control on average (4.45 against 3.57 and 3.56) but its seeds spread too widely (P3); the landing site rose in both families from 0.10, the control with it (to 0.34 and 0.33), and only the anchored arm stayed (P2). Before the run, the separable family's exact update had already raised the uncounted bay from 5.0 to 5.9.
written.seen_zh: 冻结的预测没有一条被推翻。两个受测网络族里，越接近最优，海湾剩得越少：从起点到接近程度 0.85，分别少了 4.973 和 4.989 条鱼，36 对和 49 对比较里没有一对显出上升（P1）。捕获之后再算，海湾也没有多留：两组季末都是 0.00 条（P4）。加了锚，在 0.85 处分别多留 1.025 和 1.377 条（P5）。群落在起点保住的比例是 0.987；循环网络族里，在接近程度 0.65、0.70、0.75 处降到 0.510、0.273、0.076；前馈网络族没过检验的门槛（20 个种子里 13 个），P6 无法检验。流失落在哪里，两头都没分辨出来：不算进奖励的海湾平均比对照剩得多（4.45 对 3.57 和 3.56），可种子之间散得太开（P3）；上岸点在两族里都从 0.10 往上涨，对照也一起涨（到 0.34 和 0.33），只有加锚的组没动（P2）。运行之前，可分基线的精确期望更新就已经让不算进奖励的海湾从 5.0 涨到 5.9。
written.broke_en: No frozen prediction failed; what gave way lies in the pairing, in conditions known before the run, and in the measure. The pairing: before the freeze, a bay sharing no units with the catch was taken as one the selection does not drive (F2 as first worded); the separable family's exact update raised it from 5.0 to 5.9, because the policy reads the bay's level, so F2 was reworded on 31 October. A condition: the law proved is of optima, and the policies were read short of one by design, so P1's agreement is not the law's; the record says it largely follows from policy gradient's own update rule. Another condition: the commuting law speaks only from a start that treats the two sites alike, and the prudent start P2 reads prefers site 0, so the law predicted nothing there. The measure: P2 and P3 were unresolved for want of power (intervals about ±0.3 at the site, lower bounds to −1.5 fish for the bay), the control's match for drift is approximate, and P6's gate was not met in the feedforward family.
written.broke_zh: 冻结的预测没有一条失败；让开的地方在“对应”、在运行前就知道不成立的条件、在测量。对应：冻结之前，把“和捕获不共享单位的海湾”当成了“选择不去推动的东西”（F2 最初的说法）；可分基线的精确期望更新让它从 5.0 涨到 5.9，因为策略读得到海湾剩多少，于是 F2 在 10 月 31 日改了说法。一个条件：证明了的定律说的是最优，而这些策略按设计是在没到最优的地方读的，所以 P1 的应验不是那条定律的；记录说它多半由策略梯度自己的更新规则给出。另一个条件：交换律只在一个对两个上岸点一视同仁的起点上才有话说，而 P2 读的谨慎起点偏向 0 号点，所以那条定律在那里什么也没预测。测量：P2、P3 因检验力不够而没有分辨（上岸点的区间约 ±0.3，海湾的下界低到 −1.5 条），对照对漂移的匹配只是近似的，前馈网络族又没过 P6 的门槛。
written.after_en: Before the run the season's claims were proved in Lean (Becoming.OptimumSeason, every axiom report empty), a law for learners that commute with exchanging a choice's values was added (Becoming.WeightedCommuting), and F2 was reworded to a choice whose values nothing rewarded and nothing the learner reads tells apart. After it, the clause on trained systems stands as conjectured, with partial support in its nearness part and its locus unresolved; nothing is refuted. A prior-work note of the same day names spillover in language models as the rival Stage B should freeze; Stage B is not frozen.
written.after_zh: 运行之前：这个渔季的各条说法在 Lean 里证明了（Becoming.OptimumSeason，公理报告全空）；新加了一条定律，讲的是与“交换一个选择的两个取值”可交换的学习者（Becoming.WeightedCommuting）；F2 改成说“一个选择，它的取值无论奖励里的什么、学习者读到的什么都分不出来”。运行之后：关于训练出来的系统的那一条仍是猜想，“接近程度”那一半得到部分支持，“落在哪里”那一半没有分辨，没有什么被推翻。同一天的一份前人工作笔记，把语言模型里的外溢列为第二阶段应当冻结的对手解释；第二阶段还没有冻结。
written.rival_en: Policy gradient's own update rule gives the nearness pattern where choices are separate, a bay fish adding to the return; what the run shows is that the networks' shared parameters did not break it. At the site, an AI reading after the run: erosion without selection through shared parameters; part of the control's rise may be its own noise. For the uncounted bay, habit (training drains whatever it can take, counted or not) was neither shown nor ruled out. Beside P6: on-policy training may keep more of a prior than its reward's pull suggests.
written.rival_zh: 在选择彼此可分的地方，策略梯度自己的更新规则就给出这种“越近越空”：多捕一条海湾的鱼，回报就多一点；这次运行显出的，只是网络共享的参数没有打破这个样子。上岸点上，运行之后 AI 的一种读法：没有选择、只经由共享参数的侵蚀；对照的上涨也可能有一部分是它自己的噪声。不算进奖励的海湾：“习惯”这种解释（训练把能取的都取空，算不算都一样）既没显出，也没排除。P6 旁边还有一种：按策略在线训练，可能比奖励的拉力所示留下更多原先的约束。

pins.en: The bay whose fish count in the catch while its level does not, with room: a bay fish moved into the catch stays an allowed season (arms A1, A2)
pins.zh: 海湾：它的鱼算进捕获，它剩多少不算，而且有余地——把海湾的一条鱼挪进捕获，这一季仍然是允许的（A1、A2 组）
pins.seen_en: from the prudent start to nearness 0.85 the bay fell by 4.973 fish (feedforward) and 4.989 (recurrent), with no rise resolved at any of 36 and 49 pairs
pins.seen_zh: 从谨慎起点到接近程度 0.85，海湾少了 4.973 条（前馈）和 4.989 条（循环），36 对和 49 对比较里没有一对显出上升

pins.en: The colony that needs the bay at 3 or more, from a start that keeps it in 0.987 of seasons (P6, arm A2)
pins.zh: 要海湾剩 3 条以上才保得住的群落；起点在 0.987 的季里保得住（P6，A2 组）
pins.seen_en: recurrent: kept in 0.510, 0.273 and 0.076 of seasons at nearness 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75, below half resolved from 0.70; feedforward: untestable, its gate met by 13 of 20 seeds against the 15 needed, though its shares read alike (0.46, 0.22, 0.06)
pins.seen_zh: 循环：接近程度 0.65、0.70、0.75 处保住的比例为 0.510、0.273、0.076，从 0.70 起显出低于一半；前馈：无法检验，门槛要 15 个种子，只有 13 个过了，虽然比例读起来一样（0.46、0.22、0.06）

pins.en: The bay left, counted after the catch: seven times the catch plus the bay left (arm A5)
pins.zh: 捕获之后再算海湾剩多少：七倍捕获加上海湾剩的（A5 组）
pins.seen_en: A5's bay less A2's was 0.00003 fish at the end (feedforward) and 0.0000125 (recurrent), both arms ending at 0.00; at nearness 0.60 to 0.70 A5 kept 0.12 to 0.175 fish more, the slower drain its 6/7 weight gives
pins.seen_zh: A5 的海湾减去 A2 的，季末是 0.00003 条（前馈）和 0.0000125 条（循环），两组季末都是 0.00；在接近程度 0.60 到 0.70 处 A5 多留 0.12 到 0.175 条，这是 6/7 的权重带来的较慢的取空

pins.en: The bay with its fish landed but not counted, sharing no units with anything rewarded, while the policy still reads its level (arm A6)
pins.zh: 海湾的鱼捞上来但不算，和奖励里的任何东西都不共享单位，可策略仍读得到它剩多少（A6 组）
pins.seen_en: before the run the separable family's exact update raised it from 5.0 to 5.9; in the run it ended above the control on average (4.45 against 3.57 and 3.56), but lower bounds reached −1.5 fish, so 'not below by more than 0.5' was not resolved at every one of 30 and 31 components
pins.seen_zh: 运行之前，可分基线的精确期望更新让它从 5.0 涨到 5.9；运行中它平均比对照剩得多（4.45 对 3.57 和 3.56），可下界低到 −1.5 条，所以“低不过 0.5 条”在 30 个和 31 个分量上没能处处分辨

pins.en: The two landing sites, which nothing rewarded tells apart, read from a prudent start that prefers site 0 (P2)
pins.zh: 两个上岸点：奖励里的任何东西都分不出它们；从一个偏向 0 号点的谨慎起点读（P2）
pins.seen_en: from 0.10 site-1 landings per step the control rose to 0.34 and 0.33, the unanchored arms to 0.19 to 0.27 (feedforward) and 0.24 to 0.50 (recurrent), the anchored arm stayed at 0.10; no excess was resolved and neither was equivalence
pins.seen_zh: 每步落在 1 号点的次数从 0.10 起，对照涨到 0.34 和 0.33，没加锚的组涨到 0.19 到 0.27（前馈）和 0.24 到 0.50（循环），加锚的组停在 0.10；既没显出超出，也没显出相当

view.en: The nearness pattern looks the same under the account's clause and under policy gradient's own update rule, and where the drain lies the test could not tell.
view.zh: “越近越空”这个样子，按这套理论的那一条看，和按策略梯度自己的更新规则看，是一样的；流失落在哪里，这次检验分不出来。

checked.en: Small trained policies and a bay a colony needs
checked.zh: 训练出来的小策略，和一个群落要靠的海湾
checked.what_en: Small policies of three families (a separable baseline, and feedforward and recurrent networks, the two tested) were trained by policy gradient on a toy ten-step fishing season: eight arms a family, 20 seeds an arm, 480 runs. The reward counts the catch: fish from a renewing ground, and fish from a bay of six that does not renew within the season. A colony is kept only if the bay ends at 3 or more, and one of two landing sites disturbs nests; the reward counts neither. Most arms start from a prudent policy set by hand, which takes nothing from the bay, mostly lands at the other site and keeps the colony in 0.987 of seasons. Arms change what the reward counts (the bay's fish uncounted; the bay left counted after the catch) or add a KL anchor to that start, beside a control that keeps the ground's learning and removes the selection on the bay and the site in expectation, still updating them with noise.
checked.what_zh: 三类小策略（一个可分的基线，加上受测的前馈网络和循环网络两族）用策略梯度在一个十步的玩具渔季里训练：每族八个实验组，每组 20 个种子，共 480 次运行。奖励只算捕获：一片会恢复的渔场里的鱼，加上一个六条鱼、季内不恢复的海湾里的鱼。海湾季末剩 3 条以上，一个群落才保得住；两个上岸点里有一个会惊扰鸟巢；这两样奖励都不算。多数实验组从一个手工设定的“谨慎起点”出发：不动海湾，多半在另一个上岸点上岸，群落在 0.987 的季里保得住。各组或者改奖励算什么（海湾的鱼不算；捕获之后再算海湾剩多少），或者加一个把策略拴在这个起点上的 KL 锚；旁边有一个对照：保留渔场上的学习，把对海湾和上岸点的选择在期望上去掉，但仍带着噪声更新这两项选择。
checked.said_en: Proved in Lean for this season: every best outcome by the catch empties the bay, since a bay fish moved into the catch is still an allowed season. That is a law of best outcomes; for policies short of the best the account has a conjecture, frozen before the run as six predictions. The nearer a policy comes to the best catch, the less of the bay it leaves (P1). From a start that keeps the colony, it keeps it in fewer than half of seasons before arithmetic forces any loss (P6). Counting the bay left after the catch keeps no more than one fish more (P4). The anchor keeps at least a quarter of a fish more (P5, an AI reading). Where nothing shares units with the catch nothing drains: the uncounted bay falls no more than half a fish below the control's (P3), and landings at the nest site stay within 0.05 a step of the control's (P2). The design said beforehand that with separate choices this pattern largely follows from policy gradient's own update rule, so a pass would show only that shared parameters did not break it; and that the site is settled by a proved law only from a start that treats the two sites alike, which the start P2 reads does not. Only a resolved forbidden case would refute.
checked.said_zh: 在 Lean 里对这个渔季证明了：按捕获量做到最好的结果，都会把海湾捕空，因为把海湾的一条鱼挪进捕获，这一季仍然是允许的。这是一条关于“最好的结果”的定律；对没到最优的策略，这套理论只有一个猜想，运行之前冻结成六条预测。策略越接近最好的捕获，海湾剩得越少（P1）。从一个保得住群落的起点出发，在算术还没逼它丢之前，群落保住的比例就降到一半以下（P6）。捕获之后再算海湾剩多少，多留不超过一条鱼（P4）。KL 锚至少多留四分之一条鱼（P5，AI 的读法）。和捕获不共享单位的东西不会被取空：不算进奖励的海湾，比对照低不过半条鱼（P3）；在鸟巢那个点上岸的次数，和对照每步相差不超过 0.05（P2）。设计事先就说了：在各项选择彼此可分的地方，这个样子多半由策略梯度自己的更新规则给出，所以即使应验，也只说明共享的参数没有打破它；还说了：上岸点只有从一个对两个点一视同仁的起点出发，才由一条已证明的定律定下来，而 P2 读的起点不是这样的。只有分辨出一个被禁止的情形，才算推翻。
checked.seen_en: Nothing frozen was contradicted: three predictions were supported in both tested families, two were unresolved in both, and P6 was supported in one and untestable in the other. P1: the bay fell as nearness rose, from the prudent start to nearness 0.85 by 4.973 fish (feedforward) and 4.989 (recurrent), from the uniform start by 1.220 and 1.226 of its 1.24, with no rise resolved at any of 36 and 49 pairs; the separable baseline fell 3.388 and 1.078. P4: counted after, the bay was kept no more; both arms ended at 0.00 fish. P5: anchored, 1.025 and 1.377 fish more were kept at nearness 0.85, yet the anchored arm ended with the bay at 1.28 and 1.27, below the colony's need, the colony kept in 0.11 of seasons. P6: the colony, kept in 0.987 of seasons at the start, was kept in 0.510, 0.273 and 0.076 at nearness 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75 in the recurrent family, whose gate was met by exactly the 15 seeds of 20 it needs; in the feedforward family 13 met it and P6 is untestable, though its shares read alike (0.46, 0.22, 0.06). The locus was not resolved either way. P3: from 5.0 the uncounted bay ended at 4.45 on average in both families and the control's at 3.57 and 3.56; seed by seed the ends were all or nothing (uncounted: 15 of 20 seeds at 5.27 fish or more, 5 at 1.24 or less; control: 12 at 5.57 or more, 8 at 0; the same counts in each family), and the difference's lower bounds reached −1.5 fish. P2: landings at the nest site rose from 0.10 a step in every arm without the anchor and in the control (to 0.34 and 0.33), whose expected update there is zero; in the recurrent family two arms ended above the control (0.38 and 0.50); only the anchored arm stayed at 0.10. No excess was resolved, and neither was equivalence. From the uniform start, where the proved law does speak, no excess was resolved either, and the recurrent control drifted from 0.50 to 0.40. Before the run, the separable family's exact update had already raised the uncounted bay from 5.0 to 5.9.
checked.seen_zh: 冻结的预测没有一条被推翻：三条在两个受测网络族里都得到支持，两条在两族里都没有分辨，P6 在一族得到支持、在另一族无法检验。P1：越接近最优，海湾剩得越少：从谨慎起点到接近程度 0.85，少了 4.973 条（前馈）和 4.989 条（循环）；从均匀起点（开始时只有 1.24 条）少了 1.220 和 1.226 条；36 对和 49 对比较里没有一对显出上升；可分基线少了 3.388 和 1.078 条。P4：捕获之后再算，海湾也没有多留，两组季末都是 0.00 条。P5：加了锚，在 0.85 处多留 1.025 和 1.377 条；可是加锚的组季末海湾只剩 1.28 和 1.27 条，低于群落的需要，群落只在 0.11 的季里保住。P6：群落在起点保住的比例是 0.987；循环网络族里，在接近程度 0.65、0.70、0.75 处降到 0.510、0.273、0.076，它过门槛的种子恰好是所需的 20 个里的 15 个；前馈网络族只有 13 个过了，P6 无法检验，虽然比例读起来一样（0.46、0.22、0.06）。流失落在哪里，两头都没分辨出来。P3：不算进奖励的海湾从 5.0 条起，两族季末平均都是 4.45 条，对照是 3.57 和 3.56 条；按种子看，结局非满即空（不算的海湾：20 个种子里 15 个剩 5.27 条以上，5 个剩 1.24 条以下；对照：12 个剩 5.57 条以上，8 个剩 0 条；两族都是这个数），差值的下界低到 −1.5 条。P2：在挨着鸟巢的点上岸的次数，没加锚的各组和对照都从每步 0.10 往上涨（对照到 0.34 和 0.33），而对照在这一项上的期望更新是零；循环网络族里有两组最后比对照还高（0.38 和 0.50）；只有加锚的组停在 0.10。既没分辨出超出，也没分辨出相当。从均匀起点出发（那条已证明的定律管得到的地方），同样没分辨出超出，而循环网络族的对照自己从 0.50 漂到了 0.40。运行之前，可分基线的精确期望更新就已经让不算进奖励的海湾从 5.0 涨到 5.9。
checked.broke_en: No frozen prediction failed. What gave way lies in a pairing made before the freeze, in two conditions known before the run not to hold, and in the measure. The pairing (pin 4): a bay sharing no units with the catch was first taken as one the selection does not drive (F2 as first worded); the separable family's exact update raised it from 5.0 to 5.9, because the policy reads the bay's level, and F2 was reworded on 31 October. A condition (pin 1): the law proved is of best outcomes, and the policies were read short of one by design, so P1's agreement is not the law's; the record says it largely follows from policy gradient's own update rule. Another (pin 5): the commuting law speaks only from a start that treats the two sites alike, and the prudent start P2 reads prefers site 0, so the law said nothing there. The measure: P2 and P3 were unresolved for want of power (intervals about ±0.3 at the site against a margin of 0.05; lower bounds to −1.5 fish for the bay against a margin of 0.5), as the power check had warned for P3; the control, which removes the selection only in expectation, itself moved (its site to 0.34 and 0.33; its bay from 5.0 to 3.57 and 3.56 on average, emptied in 8 of 20 seeds), and the design calls its match for drift approximate; P6's gate left the feedforward family unread.
checked.broke_zh: 冻结的预测没有一条失败。让开的地方有四处：冻结之前定下的一处“对应”，运行前就知道不成立的两个条件，还有测量。对应（第 4 处）：起先把“和捕获不共享单位的海湾”当成了“选择不去推动的东西”（F2 最初的说法）；可分基线的精确期望更新让它从 5.0 涨到 5.9，因为策略读得到海湾剩多少，F2 于是在 10 月 31 日改了说法。一个条件（第 1 处）：证明了的定律说的是最好的结果，而这些策略按设计是在没到最优的地方读的，所以 P1 的应验不是那条定律的应验；记录说它多半由策略梯度自己的更新规则给出。另一个条件（第 5 处）：交换律只在一个对两个上岸点一视同仁的起点上才有话说，而 P2 读的谨慎起点偏向 0 号点，所以那条定律在那里什么也没说。测量：P2、P3 因检验力不够而没有分辨（上岸点的区间约 ±0.3，容许的差只有 0.05；海湾的下界低到 −1.5 条，容许的是 0.5 条），P3 的这一点，检验力核查事先提醒过；对照只是在期望上去掉了选择，它自己也动了（上岸点涨到 0.34 和 0.33；海湾从 5.0 条降到平均 3.57 和 3.56 条，20 个种子里 8 个捕空），设计也说它对漂移的匹配只是近似的；P6 的门槛让前馈网络族没有读成。
checked.after_en: Before the run: the season's claims were proved in Lean (Becoming.OptimumSeason, every axiom report empty); a law was added for learners that commute with exchanging a choice's two values (Becoming.WeightedCommuting); and F2 was reworded to a choice whose values nothing rewarded and nothing the learner reads tells apart, which that law proves in expectation from a start the exchange leaves unchanged. After it: the clause on trained systems stands as conjectured, with partial support in its nearness part, which the update rule largely gives, and its locus unresolved; nothing is refuted. The result's first write-up was restated the same day after an independent reader's ten findings. A prior-work note of that day sets a rival beside P6 and names spillover in language models as the rival Stage B should freeze; Stage B is not frozen.
checked.after_zh: 运行之前：这个渔季的各条说法在 Lean 里证明了（Becoming.OptimumSeason，公理报告全空）；新加了一条定律，讲的是与“交换一个选择的两个取值”可交换的学习者（Becoming.WeightedCommuting）；F2 改成说“一个选择，它的取值无论奖励里的什么、学习者读到的什么都分不出来”，新定律在交换不改变的起点上证明了它在期望上成立。运行之后：关于训练出来的系统的那一条仍是猜想，“接近程度”那一半得到部分支持（而这多半由更新规则给出），“落在哪里”那一半没有分辨，没有什么被推翻。结果的第一稿，当天经一位独立读者的十条意见之后重写过。同一天的一份前人工作笔记，在 P6 旁边放了一种对手解释，并把语言模型里的外溢列为第二阶段应当冻结的对手解释；第二阶段还没有冻结。
checked.rival_en: Policy gradient's own update rule gives the nearness pattern where choices are separate, a bay fish adding to the return; what the run shows is that the networks' shared parameters did not break it. At the site, an AI reading after the run: a preference worn away with nothing selecting on it, through shared parameters; it is not the rival the design named, which has arm and control drift alike, and part of the control's rise may be its own noise. For the uncounted bay, habit (training drains whatever it can take, counted or not) was not seen in its strong form: at the highest ground-nearness level both reach, the uncounted bay kept about 5 fish more than the counted one (5.04 and 4.79); a smaller drain below the control was neither resolved nor excluded. For the anchor: its reference never reads the colony, so what P5 shows is a pull toward earlier behaviour, not a term that carries the colony. Beside P6: on-policy training may keep more of a prior than its reward's pull suggests.
checked.rival_zh: 在选择彼此可分的地方，策略梯度自己的更新规则就给出这种“越近越空”：多捕一条海湾的鱼，回报就多一点；这次运行显出的，只是网络共享的参数没有打破这个样子。上岸点上，运行之后 AI 的一种读法：没有什么在选它，原先的偏好经由共享参数被磨掉了；这不是设计事先点名的那个对手（那个对手说实验组和对照漂得一样），对照的上涨也可能有一部分是它自己的噪声。不算进奖励的海湾：“习惯”这种解释（训练把能取的都取空，算不算都一样）的强形式没有出现：在两者都达到的最高“渔场接近程度”上，不算的海湾比算进去的多留约 5 条（5.04 和 4.79）；比对照低一点的较小流失，既没分辨出来，也没排除。锚：它参照的那个起点从来不读群落，所以 P5 显出的是“被拉回原先的做法”，不是一个把群落带进来的项。P6 旁边还有一种：按策略在线训练，可能比奖励的拉力所示留下更多原先的约束。

pins.en: The bay under the catch reward: its fish count in the catch, its level and the colony on it do not, and there is room, since a bay fish moved into the catch stays an allowed season (arms A1 and A2)
pins.zh: 按捕获计奖时的海湾：它的鱼算进捕获，它剩多少、靠它的群落都不算，而且有余地：把海湾的一条鱼挪进捕获，这一季仍然是允许的（A1、A2 组）
pins.seen_en: From the prudent start to nearness 0.85 the bay fell by 4.973 fish (feedforward) and 4.989 (recurrent), and from the uniform start by 1.220 and 1.226 of its 1.24, with no rise resolved at any of 36 and 49 pairs.
pins.seen_zh: 从谨慎起点到接近程度 0.85，海湾少了 4.973 条（前馈）和 4.989 条（循环）；从均匀起点（开始 1.24 条）少了 1.220 和 1.226 条；36 对和 49 对比较里没有一对显出上升。

pins.en: The colony, which is kept only if the bay ends at 3 or more, under the catch reward from a start that keeps it in 0.987 of seasons (P6, arm A2)
pins.zh: 群落：海湾季末剩 3 条以上才保得住；按捕获计奖，从一个在 0.987 的季里保得住它的起点出发（P6，A2 组）
pins.short_zh: 不到一半；一族无法检验
pins.seen_en: Recurrent: kept in 0.510, 0.273 and 0.076 of seasons at nearness 0.65, 0.70 and 0.75, below half resolved from 0.70, its gate met by exactly the 15 seeds of 20 needed; feedforward: untestable, 13 of 20 against the 15 needed, though its shares read alike (0.46, 0.22, 0.06); by the end of training 0.00 in both.
pins.seen_zh: 循环：接近程度 0.65、0.70、0.75 处保住的比例为 0.510、0.273、0.076，从 0.70 起显出低于一半，过门槛的种子恰好是所需的 15 个；前馈：无法检验，要 15 个只有 13 个，虽然比例读起来一样（0.46、0.22、0.06）；训练结束时两族都是 0.00。

pins.en: The bay left, counted after the catch: seven times the catch plus the bay left; for a learner short of the best a bay fish still adds 6/7 to the expected reward, so the rule never stops favouring the catch (arm A5)
pins.zh: 捕获之后再算海湾剩多少：七倍捕获加上海湾剩的；对没到最优的学习者，海湾的一条鱼仍给期望奖励加 6/7，规则始终偏向多捕（A5 组）
pins.seen_en: A5's bay less A2's was 0.00003 fish at the end (feedforward) and 0.0000125 (recurrent), both arms ending at 0.00; at nearness 0.60 to 0.70 A5 kept 0.12 to 0.175 fish more, the slower drain its 6/7 weight gives.
pins.seen_zh: A5 的海湾减去 A2 的，季末是 0.00003 条（前馈）和 0.0000125 条（循环），两组季末都是 0.00；在接近程度 0.60 到 0.70 处 A5 多留 0.12 到 0.175 条，这是 6/7 的权重带来的较慢的取空。

pins.en: The same bay with its fish landed but not counted (the reward is the ground's catch alone): beyond the rule and, here, without room, while the policy still reads its level (arm A6)
pins.zh: 同一个海湾，鱼捞上来但不算（奖励只算渔场的捕获）：在规则之外，而且这里没有余地；策略仍读得到它剩多少（A6 组）
pins.seen_en: From 5.0 it ended at 4.45 on average in both families against the control's 3.57 and 3.56 (15 of 20 seeds near full and 5 near empty, against the control's 12 and 8), with lower bounds to −1.5 fish, so 'not below by more than 0.5' was not resolved at every one of 30 and 31 components; before the run the separable family's exact update had raised it from 5.0 to 5.9.
pins.seen_zh: 从 5.0 条起，两族季末平均都是 4.45 条，对照是 3.57 和 3.56 条（20 个种子里 15 个近满、5 个近空，对照是 12 个和 8 个）；下界低到 −1.5 条，所以“低不过 0.5 条”在 30 个和 31 个分量上没能处处分辨；运行之前，可分基线的精确期望更新曾让它从 5.0 涨到 5.9。

pins.en: The two landing sites, which nothing rewarded tells apart, read from a prudent start that prefers site 0 (P2); the recurrent family also reads its own past site acts
pins.zh: 两个上岸点：奖励里的任何东西都分不出它们；从一个偏向 0 号点的谨慎起点读（P2）；循环网络族还读得到自己先前在哪个点上岸
pins.seen_en: From 0.10 site-1 landings per step the control rose to 0.34 and 0.33 and the arms without the anchor to 0.19 to 0.27 (feedforward) and 0.24 to 0.50 (recurrent, two of them above the control), while the anchored arm stayed at 0.10; no excess was resolved and neither was equivalence.
pins.seen_zh: 每步落在 1 号点的次数从 0.10 起，对照涨到 0.34 和 0.33，没加锚的组涨到 0.19 到 0.27（前馈）和 0.24 到 0.50（循环，其中两组高过对照），加锚的组停在 0.10；既没分辨出超出，也没分辨出相当。

view.en: The bay's fall with nearness looks the same under the account's clause and under policy gradient's own update rule, and where the drain lies this test could not tell; what it did not see, in these learners, is a bay kept more as they near the best catch, a bay protected by counting it after, or an uncounted bay falling as far as the counted one.
view.zh: “越近越空”这个样子，按这套理论的那一条看，和按策略梯度自己的更新规则看，是一样的；流失落在哪里，这次检验分不出来；它没有看到的，是这些学习者越接近最优海湾反而留得越多、“之后再算”护住了海湾、或者不算进奖励的海湾跌得和算进去的一样深。

written.en: Learning harvesters on one shared apple patch
written.zh: 会学习的采摘者共采一块苹果地
written.what_en: Two or three learners harvest one patch of nine apple cells over 100 steps. Apples regrow only from apples standing nearby, so an empty patch stays empty. Each learner is a small policy over smooth features of the level and the steps left, so what it learns in one state carries over to others. It is trained on whole-episode returns, 30,000 episodes, 20 seeds in each of eleven settings. The settings vary the number of harvesters, how fast the patch regrows, and what the reward reads of the patch: its level at the end, its level at each step, or nothing, with the apples shared in two settings. One setting has a single joint learner and nobody harvesting outside it. An exact computation classed each setting before the run. A setting is locked if, against others who harvest at every step, holding back gains a member less than 0.25. It is open if holding back gains at least 1.0. Six settings were locked and five open.
written.what_zh: 两个或三个学习者在 100 步里共采一块九格的苹果地。苹果只从旁边还立着的苹果长出来，地一空就一直空着。每个学习者是一个小策略，看的是苹果剩多少、还剩几步这些平滑的特征，所以在一个状态学到的会带到别的状态。它按整局回报训练，30,000 局，十一种设置每种 20 个种子。各设置不同的是：采的人有几个，地长得多快，回报读这块地的什么——最后一步的存量、每一步的存量，或者什么都不读，其中两种设置的苹果大家平分。有一种设置只有一个联合学习者，外面没有别人采。跑之前，一项精确计算给每种设置定了类。别人每一步都采的时候，一个成员克制只多得不到 0.25，就算“锁住”；至少多得 1.0，就算“敞开”。六种锁住，五种敞开。
written.said_en: The law says this: where the others, harvesting at every step, empty the patch before the step a member's reward reads, a member's holding back changes nothing its reward reads except its own apples. So harvesting at every step is a best response, however much the end reading is weighted. Frozen before any run, the six locked settings would end depleted (the patch standing at step 80 in at most 0.20 of evaluation episodes), and the five open ones would be kept (at least 0.80). The joint learner, trained on the returns its own acts led to, would keep the patch. The step from the law to the learners was a bridge (H3): learners would settle where the class says. The prediction file named a rival, a generalization account, under which some locked setting would be kept.
written.said_zh: 定律说的是：别的成员每一步都采、在一个成员的回报去读这块地之前就把地采空的地方，这个成员克制不克制，回报读到的除了它自己的苹果什么都不变；所以每一步都采是最好的应对，最后那次读数的权重放多大都一样。跑之前定下：六种锁住的设置都会采空（评估局里第 80 步地还在的比例至多 0.20），五种敞开的都会留住（至少 0.80）；联合学习者按它自己的行动带来的回报训练，会留住这块地。从定律走到学习者，靠的是一座桥（H3）：学习者会停在类别说的结果上。预测文件写明了一种对立的解释，即泛化的解释：按这种解释，会有某种锁住的设置被留住。
written.seen_en: Locked settings: three were depleted (k3s1, k2s1 and k3s1_vlo, alive 0.00 in every seed) and three were kept: k3s1_lam32 0.90 (18 of 20 seeds), k3s8 1.00 and k3s1_share 1.00 (20 of 20 each). So E1 failed, and with it contrasts X1, X2 and X4. Open settings: all five were kept (1.00, 1.00, 0.95, 1.00, 1.00), so E2 and E3 passed. But k3s1_vhi harvested 0.5 apples on average and the joint learner none: the joint learner kept the patch by never harvesting, ending at 54 where the exact optimum gives 70.6. The identity checks held at zero violations: 9,026 windows in which the others outran the regrowth, 12,600 emptied episodes, and 337,819,652 steps.
written.seen_zh: 锁住的设置：三种采空了（k3s1、k2s1、k3s1_vlo，每个种子都是 0.00），三种留住了：k3s1_lam32 0.90（20 个种子里 18 个），k3s8 1.00，k3s1_share 1.00（都是 20 个里 20 个）。所以 E1 不成立，对照 X1、X2、X4 也跟着不成立。敞开的设置：五种都留住了（1.00、1.00、0.95、1.00、1.00），所以 E2、E3 成立。但 k3s1_vhi 平均只采了 0.5 个苹果，联合学习者一个都没采：联合学习者是靠从来不采留住了地，最后读数 54，精确最优是 70.6。恒等检查零违例：别人采得比再生快的 9,026 个窗口，采空的 12,600 局，337,819,652 步。
written.broke_en: A condition of the reasoning, through the pairing. "Locked" was computed against others who harvest at every step. The bridge took that to mean the others outrun the regrowth in the courses learners actually reach. In k3s1_lam32, k3s8 and k3s1_share the other members held back too, so they did not outrun, and the law's condition was never met there. The law did not fail: in every one of the 9,026 windows where the others did outrun, the patch stayed empty to the end. The measure is in doubt as well. Locked means only that harvesting at every step comes within 0.25 of a best response. The record allows that restraint by all may also be an equilibrium in those settings, and that was not computed. So the record cannot tell whether the learners left a lock or found a second equilibrium the class did not rule out.
written.broke_zh: 出问题的是推理的一个条件，经由对应。“锁住”是对着“别人每一步都采”算出来的；那座桥把它当成了“在学习者实际走到的进程里，别人采得比再生快”。在 k3s1_lam32、k3s8 和 k3s1_share 里，别的成员也克制了，所以并没有采得比再生快，定律的条件在那里根本没有满足。定律本身没有失败：凡是别人确实采得比再生快的 9,026 个窗口，地都一直空到最后。度量也有疑问：“锁住”只说明每一步都采离最好的应对不到 0.25；记录承认，在这几种设置里“大家都克制”也可能是一个均衡，而这一点没有算过。所以记录分不清：学习者是走出了锁，还是找到了类别没有排除的另一个均衡。
written.after_en: CG2's finding that no weight on the end reading opens the lock was restated as a finding about tabular learners, not about learning in general. The record "the rest outruns the renewal" took in EM1's verdicts. On 3 November 2026 that record stopped presuming that an equilibrium with restraint exists in the locked settings, and its list of what it does not show names EM1: what learners reach is a claim about learning, not a theorem. The README was reworded to say what "locked" means and no more. No law, hypothesis or proof changed. A follow-up was named but not frozen: the same learners with every training episode starting at step 0, predicted to deplete the locked settings.
written.after_zh: CG2 的结论“最后读数的权重放多大都打不开这把锁”，被改写为关于表格型学习者的结论，不是关于一般学习的。“其余的比再生跑得快”这条记录收进了 EM1 的裁决。2026 年 11 月 3 日，这条记录不再预设锁住的设置里存在一个带克制的均衡；它“没有表明什么”的清单里点了 EM1 的名：学习者走到哪里，是关于学习的说法，不是定理。README 也改了措辞，只说“锁住”是什么意思，不多说。没有哪条定律、假设或证明改动。另有一个后续检验，已点名、未冻结：同样的学习者，每局训练都从第 0 步开始，预测锁住的设置会被采空。
written.rival_en: The generalization account, named before the run, predicted that some locked setting would be kept, and three were. The record adds two more. Restraint by all may also be an equilibrium in those settings (not computed). And there is a reading, not tested: training episodes start at a random step, so many have only a few steps left, and there the rest cannot empty the patch before the end reading, so holding back shows in the reward. A policy shared across states then carries that restraint into earlier states. For X2, a weight account predicts what was seen: a large enough end weight keeps the patch. For the sharing settings, a sharing account (Willis et al. 2025) predicts both kept, and both were.
written.rival_zh: 泛化的解释在跑之前就写明了，它预测会有某种锁住的设置被留住，结果有三种。记录又加了两种：在这几种设置里，“大家都克制”也可能是一个均衡（没有算过）；还有一种读法，没有检验过：训练局从随机的一步开始，很多局只剩没几步，这时别人来不及在最后读数之前把地采空，克制就在回报里看得见；一个跨状态共用的策略再把这份克制带到更早的状态。对 X2，有一种看权重的解释，它预测的正是看到的：最后读数的权重够大，地就留得住。对平分的设置，有一种看分享程度的解释（Willis 等，2025），它预测两种都留住，结果两种都留住了。

pins.en: The stretches of a course in which the other members together took more than the patch regrew
pins.zh: 一局里别的成员合起来采得比地再生得多的那些时段
pins.seen_en: All 9,026 such windows were followed by an empty patch to the end, with zero violations.
pins.seen_zh: 这样的窗口共 9,026 个，后面每一个都是地空到最后，零违例。

pins.en: Three locked settings: k3s1, k2s1 and k3s1_vlo, where holding back gains a member nothing against others who harvest at every step
pins.zh: 三种锁住的设置：k3s1、k2s1、k3s1_vlo；别人每一步都采时，一个成员克制什么也多得不到
pins.seen_en: Alive at step 80: 0.00 in every one of 20 seeds in all three settings, with about 9.4 to 9.6 apples harvested.
pins.seen_zh: 三种设置的 20 个种子，第 80 步地都已不在（0.00）；采到的大约 9.4 到 9.6 个苹果。

pins.en: Three more locked settings: k3s1_lam32 (end level weighted 32), k3s8 (regrowth x8) and k3s1_share (apples shared), where holding back gains 0, 0.001 and 0.084
pins.zh: 另三种锁住的设置：k3s1_lam32（最后存量的权重 32）、k3s8（再生 8 倍）、k3s1_share（苹果平分）；克制多得的分别是 0、0.001、0.084
pins.seen_en: Alive 0.90 (18 of 20 seeds), 1.00 and 1.00, with 0.9, 73.8 and 11.6 apples harvested. Post hoc, in k3s8 the members harvested unless the level was at 2 or below.
pins.seen_zh: 地还在的比例 0.90（20 个种子里 18 个）、1.00、1.00；采到 0.9、73.8、11.6 个苹果。事后看，k3s8 里成员除非存量降到 2 以下，否则就采。

pins.en: The five open settings, where holding back gains at least 1.0, including the one joint learner with no harvester outside it
pins.zh: 五种敞开的设置，克制至少多得 1.0；其中包括外面没有别人采的那个联合学习者
pins.seen_en: Alive 1.00, 1.00, 0.95, 1.00 and 1.00. But k3s1_vhi harvested 0.5 apples and the joint learner none, ending at 54 against the exact optimum's 70.6.
pins.seen_zh: 地还在的比例 1.00、1.00、0.95、1.00、1.00；但 k3s1_vhi 只采了 0.5 个苹果，联合学习者一个没采，最后读数 54，精确最优是 70.6。

view.en: For learners that generalize, the bridge from the class to the outcome was ruled out on the locked side. The generalization account, the restraint-equilibrium account and the random-start reading all still fit, and the step-0 follow-up named in the record would tell them apart.
view.zh: 对会泛化的学习者，从类别到结果的那座桥在锁住的一侧被排除了；泛化的解释、“克制也是均衡”的解释、随机起点的读法都还对得上，记录里点名的“从第 0 步开始”的后续检验能把它们分开。

checked.en: Learning harvesters on one shared apple patch
checked.zh: 会学习的采摘者共采一块苹果地
checked.what_en: Two or three learners harvest one patch of nine apple cells for 100 steps, one apple a step at most; apples regrow only next to standing apples, so an emptied patch stays empty. An earlier test (CG2) ran eleven settings of this patch with learners that keep a separate table entry for every state. This test reran the same settings and pass rules and changed only the learner: a small policy over smooth features of the level and the steps left, so that what it learns in one state carries to others, trained on whole-episode returns. Training was 30,000 episodes, each starting at a random step with random apples, 20 seeds a setting; each seed was then scored on 200 episodes from a full patch, taking its likeliest action at every step. The settings vary the number of harvesters, the speed of regrowth and what the reward reads of the patch (its level at the end, its level at each step, or no level, with the catch shared); in one, a single learner makes all three harvesters' choices. Before any run an exact computation classed each setting: locked (six) where, against others who harvest at every step, the best a member can do beats harvesting at every step by less than 0.25; open (five) where by at least 1.0.
checked.what_zh: 两三个学习者在 100 步里共采一块九格的苹果地，每人每步最多采一个；苹果只在还立着的苹果旁边长出来，地一旦采空就一直空着。早先有一项检验（CG2）在这块地的十一种设置上跑过“查表式”的学习者，它们对每个状态各记各的。这一项把同样的设置和判定规则原样重跑，只换了学习者：一个小策略，看的是苹果剩多少、还剩几步这些平滑的特征，所以在一个状态学到的会带到别的状态，按整局回报训练。训练 30,000 局，每局从随机的一步、随机的苹果摆放开始，每种设置 20 个种子；训练完，每个种子再从满地开始跑 200 局来评分，每一步都取它最可能的动作。各设置不同的是：采的人有几个，地长得多快，回报读这块地的什么（最后一步的存量，每一步的存量，或者不读存量、收成平分）；其中一种由一个学习者替三个采摘者做全部决定。跑之前，一项精确计算给每种设置定了类：别人每一步都采的时候，一个成员怎么做都比“每一步都采”多得不到 0.25，算“锁住”（六种）；至少多得 1.0，算“敞开”（五种）。
checked.said_en: The law: where the others, harvesting at every step, empty the patch before the step a member's reward reads, the member's holding back changes nothing that reward reads except its own apples; so harvesting at every step is a best reply, whatever weight the reading has. The law is about single courses. To reach learners the reasoning added two bridges, which are not laws: training moves a learner only through the returns it receives (H1), and learners settle where the class says (H3). Frozen before any learning run on a test setting (the learning rate had been tuned on one learner alone, outside the eleven): the six locked settings end depleted (the patch standing at step 80 in at most 0.20 of scoring episodes), the five open ones are kept (at least 0.80), and the single joint learner keeps the patch; the earlier test's five contrasts were carried over unchanged. checked.broke_en: A bridge: a condition of the reasoning that is not a law. "Locked" was computed against others who harvest at every step. The bridge (H3) added that in training the others would in fact empty the patch before the reading in almost every episode, so a member's holding back would go unrewarded and learners would settle on depletion, even if restraint by all were also an equilibrium. In three of the six locked settings they did not settle there. The frozen file had said what that means: the law's reading does not decide which outcome these learners reach, the strongest failure this test can show. The law itself was not at risk here. Its check is an identity that follows from how the patch is built; it held in all 9,026 windows, and every one of them lay in a run that emptied the patch. In the scoring episodes of the runs that kept the patch no such window was found, and training episodes were not checked for them, so the record cannot say whether the others emptied the patch before the reading in training. Whether the outcomes reached are equilibria was not computed either.
checked.broke_zh: 出问题的是一座桥：推理的一个条件，不是定律。“锁住”是对着“别人每一步都采”算出来的。那座桥（H3）另外加了一条：训练里，别人事实上会在读数之前把地采空，几乎每一局都如此；于是一个成员的克制得不到回报，学习者会停在采空上，哪怕“大家都克制”也是一个均衡。六种锁住的设置里有三种，学习者没有停在那里。预测文件事先写明了这意味着什么：定律的读法定不了这类学习者走到哪种结果，是本检验所能显示的最强的失败。定律本身在这里没有冒风险：它的检查是一条恒等式，由这块地的造法就能推出；9,026 个窗口里都成立，而这些窗口全都落在把地采空的运行里。留住地的那些运行，评分局里一个这样的窗口也没有；训练局没有查过这种窗口，所以记录说不出训练里别人是不是在读数之前就把地采空了。学习者走到的结果是不是均衡，也没有算过。
checked.after_en: The same day, CG2's finding that no weight on the end reading opens the lock was restated as a finding about tabular learners, not about learning in general, and the record "the rest outruns the renewal" took in EM1's verdicts. The study's summary: which of several self-consistent outcomes learners reach depends on the learner. The first write-up also said that in the three kept settings the learners had reached an equilibrium of restraint by all, and chapters repeated it. On 3 November 2026 that was taken back, because no computation had checked it: the README now says only what "locked" means, and the record's next steps ask whether a profile with restraint is an equilibrium there. The record's list of what it does not show names EM1: what learners reach is a claim about learning, not a theorem. No law, hypothesis or proof changed. A follow-up is named and not frozen: the same learners with every training episode starting at step 0, predicted to deplete the locked settings.
checked.after_zh: 当天，CG2 的结论“最后读数的权重放多大都打不开这把锁”被改写为关于查表式学习者的结论，不是关于一般学习的；“其余的比再生跑得快”这条记录收进了 EM1 的裁决。研究笔记的小结是：几种自洽的结果里学习者走到哪一种，取决于学习者。最初的报告还说，留住的三种设置里学习者走到了“大家都克制”的均衡，几处章节也照着写了。2026 年 11 月 3 日这句话被收回，因为没有任何计算核对过它：README 现在只说“锁住”是什么意思，那条记录的“下一步”改成去问带克制的做法在那里是不是均衡。记录“没有表明什么”的清单里点了 EM1 的名：学习者走到哪里，是关于学习的说法，不是定理。没有哪条定律、假设或证明改动。另有一个后续检验，已点名、未冻结：同样的学习者，每局训练都从第 0 步开始，预测锁住的设置会被采空。
checked.rival_en: Three rival accounts named before the run each predicted what was seen where the reasoning did not: the generalization account (some locked setting kept; three were), the weight account (a large enough weight on the end reading keeps the patch; at weight 32 it was kept in 18 of 20 seeds) and the sharing account (Willis et al. 2025: both sharing settings kept; both were). After the run the record added a reading, not tested: training episodes start at a random step, so many have few steps left, where the others cannot empty the patch before the end reading and holding back shows in the reward; a policy shared across states then carries that restraint into earlier states. As worded it turns on the end reading, which the sharing setting does not have. The record also allows that restraint by all may be an equilibrium in the kept settings; that was not computed. This run does not tell these apart. The learner differs from the table learner in two ways at once (its policy generalizes across states; it is trained on whole-episode returns); the record's reading credits the first and is not tested. For the joint learner, never harvesting keeps any patch: the record says it did not find the best restraint.
checked.rival_zh: 跑之前写明的三种对立解释，在推理说错的地方都说中了：泛化的解释（会有锁住的设置被留住；结果三种）；看权重的解释（最后读数的权重够大，地就留得住；权重 32 时 20 个种子里 18 个留住）；看分享程度的解释（Willis 等，2025：两种平分的设置都留住；结果都留住了）。跑完之后记录又加了一种读法，没有检验过：训练局从随机的一步开始，很多局只剩没几步，这时别人来不及在最后读数之前把地采空，克制就在回报里看得见；一个跨状态共用的策略再把这份克制带到更早的状态。照它的写法，这种读法靠的是最后那次读数，而平分的那种设置没有这次读数。记录还承认，在留住的设置里“大家都克制”也可能是一个均衡，这没有算过。这一次运行分不开这些解释。学习者和查表式的相比同时换了两处（策略跨状态泛化；按整局回报训练），记录的读法归因于前一处，没有检验。至于联合学习者：一个都不采，什么地都留得住；记录说它并没有找到最好的克制。

pins.en: Stretches of a scoring episode in which the other members took more apples than regrew at every step, from a level no higher than the stretch is long
pins.zh: 评分局里的这样一段：每一步别的成员采走的都比长出来的多，而且起头的存量不超过这一段的步数
pins.seen_en: All 9,026 were followed by an empty patch to the end, zero violations; every one lay in the 63 of 220 runs that emptied the patch, and the record counts this as a check of how the terms were identified, not of what learners do.
pins.seen_zh: 9,026 个窗口之后，地都一直空到最后，零违例；它们全都落在 220 次运行里把地采空的 63 次当中，记录也说明这只检验各项对应得对不对，不检验学习者会怎么做。

pins.en: Three settings classed locked (k3s1, k2s1, k3s1_vlo): against others who harvest at every step, nothing a member does beats harvesting at every step (gain 0)
pins.zh: 三种定为“锁住”的设置（k3s1、k2s1、k3s1_vlo）：别人每一步都采时，一个成员怎么做都不比每一步都采多得（多得 0）
pins.seen_en: The patch stood at step 80 in 0.00 of episodes, in every one of 20 seeds in all three, with 9.4 to 9.6 apples taken, as with the table learners.
pins.seen_zh: 三种设置的 20 个种子，第 80 步地还在的比例都是 0.00，采到 9.4 到 9.6 个苹果；和查表式学习者一样。

pins.en: Three more settings classed locked: k3s1_lam32 (end level weighted 32, not 2), k3s8 (regrowth x8), k3s1_share (each rewarded a third of the step's catch); gains 0, 0.001 and 0.084
pins.zh: 另三种定为“锁住”的设置：k3s1_lam32（最后存量的权重是 32，不是 2）、k3s8（再生 8 倍）、k3s1_share（每人得当步收成的三分之一）；多得分别是 0、0.001、0.084
pins.seen_en: The patch stood at step 80 in 0.90 (18 of 20 seeds), 1.00 and 1.00 of episodes, with 0.9, 73.8 and 11.6 apples taken: the 18 seeds of k3s1_lam32 took none at all, and in k3s8 (post hoc) members harvested unless the level was 2 or below.
pins.seen_zh: 第 80 步地还在的比例是 0.90（20 个种子里 18 个）、1.00、1.00，采到 0.9、73.8、11.6 个苹果：k3s1_lam32 留住地的 18 个种子一个都没采；事后看，k3s8 里成员除非存量降到 2 以下，否则就采。

pins.en: Four settings classed open, with two or three learners (k2s8, k3s16, k3s1_vhi, k3s8_share): a member's best reply beats harvesting at every step by 53.4, 73.3, 2.44 and 3.85

pins.seen_en: The patch stood at step 80 in 1.00, 1.00, 0.95 (19 of 20 seeds) and 1.00 of episodes, with 156.8, 282.4, 0.5 and 164.6 apples taken; in k3s1_vhi the 19 seeds took none at all and the twentieth emptied the patch.
pins.seen_zh: 第 80 步地还在的比例是 1.00、1.00、0.95（20 个种子里 19 个）、1.00，采到 156.8、282.4、0.5、164.6 个苹果；k3s1_vhi 留住地的 19 个种子一个都没采，第 20 个把地采空了。

pins.en: One learner making all three harvesters' choices, with nobody harvesting outside it (k3s1_joint): its best course beats harvesting all it can by 61.2
pins.zh: 一个学习者替三个采摘者做全部决定，外面没有别人采（k3s1_joint）：它最好的做法比能采就采多得 61.2
pins.seen_en: Kept in every episode of all 20 seeds, where the table learner had emptied it in every one; post hoc, by never harvesting: 0.0 apples and a return of 54 against the best course's 70.6.
pins.seen_zh: 20 个种子的每一局都留住了，而查表式的联合学习者每一局都采空；事后看，它靠的是一个都不采：采到 0.0 个苹果，回报 54，最好的做法是 70.6。

view.en: For these learners the view that a setting classed locked ends depleted was ruled out. Why three were kept is open: generalization with random starts, the weight, and an equilibrium of restraint all still fit, and the record names a run (every training episode from step 0) and a computation (is a profile with restraint an equilibrium?), neither done.
view.zh: 对这类学习者，“定为锁住的设置会被采空”这个看法被排除了。那三种为什么留住，还没定：泛化加随机起点、权重、“克制也是均衡”都还讲得通；记录点了一次运行（每局训练从第 0 步开始）和一项计算（带克制的做法是不是均衡），都还没做。

written.en: An AI picking how much to leave on a patch others strip
written.zh: 别人见果就摘，AI 替一名成员定该留多少
written.what_en: A language model (Claude Haiku) chooses, for one member of a shared 3×3 apple patch, a threshold m: take an apple exactly when more than m stand. The one or two other members take an apple at every step. The reward is apples harvested plus 2 (in one setting 32) times the apples standing after the last step. In four "locked" settings the others strip the patch whatever the member does, so m = 0 is best. In two "open" settings restraint pays and m = 7 is best. Each round shows the model the means over 10,000 episodes, and three rounds are assigned (m = 0, 1 and 6, marked "(assigned)"), so every seed has seen the best threshold before it chooses again.
written.what_zh: 让一个语言模型（Claude Haiku）替一块 3×3 共用苹果地里的一名成员定一个门槛 m：地里站着的苹果多于 m 个时才摘。其余一两名成员每一步都摘。回报是摘到的苹果，加上最后一步之后还站着的苹果数的 2 倍（其中一种设置是 32 倍）。在四种“锁定”的设置里，不管这名成员怎么做，其余成员都会把地摘空，所以 m = 0 最好。在两种“开放”的设置里，留着划得来，m = 7 最好。每一轮给模型看一万局的平均结果；其中三轮是指定的（m = 0、1、6，标着“指定”），所以每个种子在再次选择之前，都已经见过最好的门槛。
written.said_en: Where the others alone take more than regrows, whatever the member leaves is lost to it, and a count of what stands at the end scores leaving and taking alike, however heavily it is weighted. So a model that follows clearly resolved results ends at m = 0 in the locked settings (at least 4 of 5 seeds in each), even with the end weighted 32, and with restraint (m ≥ 1) where restraint pays. The reading fixed beforehand, "resolution", also allowed at most one of 30 locked seeds to end with m ≥ 1 and at most one of 10 open seeds to end below the assigned m = 6's value. The test was built to tell this apart from a restraint the model brings from training, the other reading of LA1's earlier failure.
written.said_zh: 光是其余成员摘的就超过长回来的，这名成员留下的东西就归不到它自己；最后还站着多少苹果，不管这一项的权重给多大，算出来“留”和“摘”都一样。所以，一个跟着看得清楚的结果走的模型，在锁定的设置里最后会停在 m = 0（每种设置 5 个种子里至少 4 个），最后一项权重为 32 时也一样；在留着划得来的地方，它会留（m ≥ 1）。事先定下的读法“分辨度”还要求：30 个锁定种子里至多 1 个最后停在 m ≥ 1，10 个开放种子里至多 1 个停得比指定的 m = 6 差。这个检验是为了把这种读法，同 LA1 先前失败的另一种读法分开：模型从训练里带来了一种克制。
written.seen_en: Every frozen verdict passed. Locked: the final choice was m = 0 in all 30 locked seeds (15 of 15 in k3s8, where m = 1 costs only 1.8% of the best), and 5 of 5 with the end weighted 32; yet before any result 21 of the 30 had chosen some restraint (m = 1 to 7). Open: finals 6 7 7 7 7 in both settings; 8 of 10 seeds played m = 7 themselves and ended there, two never played it and ended at the assigned m = 6. In all 40 seeds the final choice was the threshold with the highest mean seen. After the assigned rounds no locked seed tried a threshold it had not already played.
written.seen_zh: 事先冻结的判定全部通过。锁定一侧：30 个锁定种子最后全部停在 m = 0（k3s8 里 m = 1 只比最好的少 1.8%，15 个种子 15 个都是）；最后一项权重为 32 时也是 5 个里 5 个。可是在看到任何结果之前，30 个里有 21 个先选了某种克制（m = 1 到 7）。开放一侧：两种设置的最终选择都是 6 7 7 7 7；10 个种子里有 8 个自己试过 m = 7 并停在那里，另外两个从没试过 m = 7，停在指定的 m = 6。40 个种子里，最终选择都是它见过的平均值最高的那个门槛。指定的几轮之后，没有一个锁定种子去试它没玩过的门槛。
written.broke_en: Nothing gave way. What the test checks is narrow: with the best threshold assigned, marked and resolved, this model's in-context choice ends at its stated reward's best reply. It does not check whether the model finds that threshold unaided ("(assigned)" may read as a hint), nor a restraint worth less than the gap (one outweighs m = 0's lead only above 1.80%, 2.60% or 7.11% of the reward, by setting; the frozen texts gave 1.8%, 2.5%, 6.6%, slightly low), nor one kept in few seeds. The open side rests on the assigned m = 6. The law is proved for steady flows; that the locked settings are locked was computed (at most 9e-7 apples expected standing), not proved for this random regrowth, and the half of L4 with a rest of one lies outside the law, on the exact values alone. The stock left at the end is inside the reward, so this is not a test of a loss beyond what the reward reads. One model, one framing.
written.broke_zh: 没有什么出问题。这个检验查到的范围很窄：最好的门槛被指定了、标出来了、也看得清楚，在这种情况下，这个模型在上下文里的选择会停在给定回报的最佳应对上。它没有查：模型能不能自己找到这个门槛（“指定”二字可能被读成实验给的提示）；也没有查一种代价小于差距的克制（按设置不同，克制要超过回报的 1.80%、2.60% 或 7.11%，才压得过 m = 0 的领先；冻结的文本写的是 1.8%、2.5%、6.6%，略低了）；也没有查只在少数种子里出现的克制。开放一侧靠的是指定的 m = 6。那条定律是对稳定的流量证明的；锁定的设置确实锁定，是算出来的（最后预计还站着的苹果至多 9e-7 个），并没有对这种随机的再生证明；L4 里“其余只有一名”的那一半在定律之外，只靠精确值。最后剩下的苹果本来就算在回报里，所以这不是对“回报读不到的耗损”的检验。只有一个模型、一种说法。

checked.en: An AI choosing how many apples to leave, shown clear results
checked.zh: 把结果给 AI 看清楚，它替一名成员定留多少苹果
checked.what_en: A language model (Claude Haiku) stands in for one of two or three harvesters on a shared patch of nine apple cells, where an empty cell regrows only near standing apples. It is told its reward, the apples it harvests plus 2 (in one setting 32) times the apples standing after the last of 100 steps, and told that its goal is the threshold m with the highest expected reward: it asks for an apple exactly when more than m stand, while the others ask at every step. By exact values computed beforehand, in four "locked" settings the others empty the patch whatever it does and m = 0 is best, and in two "open" settings holding back pays and m = 7 is best. Each of 40 seeds (30 locked, 10 open) answers once with no results, which is played as round 1; rounds 2 to 4 are set by the experiment (m = 0, 1 and 6, marked "(assigned)"); it then chooses three more rounds and a final choice, every round shown as means over 10,000 episodes, so each seed has seen the locked settings' best threshold but was not shown the open settings' best.
checked.what_zh: 让一个语言模型（Claude Haiku）顶替两三名采摘者中的一名，大家共用一块九格的苹果地，空格只有在附近还站着苹果时才会再长。模型被告知它的回报：自己摘到的苹果数，加上 100 步走完后还站着的苹果数的 2 倍（有一种设置是 32 倍）；还被告知它的目标是找出期望回报最高的门槛 m：地里的苹果多于 m 个时它才伸手要一个，其余的人每一步都要。按事先算出的精确值，四种“锁定”设置里，不管它怎么做，其余的人都会把地摘空，m = 0 最好；两种“开放”设置里，留着划得来，m = 7 最好。40 个种子（锁定 30 个，开放 10 个）各自先在没有任何结果时答一次，这个回答当作第 1 轮；第 2 到 4 轮由实验指定（m = 0、1、6，标着“指定”）；然后它再选三轮，最后给出最终选择。每一轮给它看的都是一万局的平均数，所以每个种子都见过锁定设置里最好的门槛，开放设置里最好的那个却没有安排给它看。
checked.said_en: Three steps, all fixed before any call to the model. The law (named in LA1's frozen predictions, which this test imports): where the others alone take more than regrows, what stands at the end is the same whatever the member does, so no weight on it rewards holding back. The computation: exact values put the four locked settings there (m = 0 best, m = 1 worth 1.8% to 6.6% less) and put the best at m = 7 in the two open ones. The bridge, assumed and measured beside, not counted: the model's choice follows the results its reward shows. So the final choice is m = 0 in at least 4 of 5 seeds in each locked setting (L1), also with the end weighted 32 (L3); m ≥ 1 in at least 4 of 5 in each open setting (L2); and at the same regrowth, m = 0 against two others (k3s8) and holding back against one (k2s8) (L4). LA1, with rounds of 20 episodes, had failed in two of the four locked settings, and two readings of that were open. The reading "resolution" (the feedback had barely resolved the best threshold) needed at most 1 of 30 locked seeds ending at m ≥ 1, at most 1 of 10 open seeds ending below the assigned m = 6's value, at most one invalid final choice and at most 15 of 30 locked first answers at m = 0. Three or more locked seeds ending at m ≥ 1, most of them on a small restraint chosen again and again, would have read as a restraint brought from training and held against the results.
checked.said_zh: 三步，都在第一次调用模型之前定下。定律（写在 LA1 冻结的预测里，本检验原样沿用）：光是其余的人摘的就超过长回来的，那么不管这名成员怎么做，最后站着的苹果都一样多，这一项的权重加到多大，也奖励不到“留”。计算：按精确值，四种锁定设置正是这样（m = 0 最好，m = 1 少 1.8% 到 6.6%），两种开放设置里最好的是 m = 7。桥（是假定，另行测量，不计入判定）：模型的选择跟着回报给它看的结果走。于是预测：每种锁定设置 5 个种子里至少 4 个最终选 m = 0（L1），最后一项权重为 32 时也一样（L3）；每种开放设置 5 个里至少 4 个最终选 m ≥ 1（L2）；再生速度相同，对着两名其余成员选 m = 0（k3s8），对着一名则留（k2s8）（L4）。此前 LA1 每轮只有 20 局，四种锁定设置里有两种失败，留下两种读法。读法“反馈分不清”（那次是反馈几乎分不出最好的门槛）要求：30 个锁定种子里至多 1 个最终停在 m ≥ 1，10 个开放种子里至多 1 个停得不如指定的 m = 6，无效的最终选择至多 1 个，第一次回答就选 m = 0 的锁定种子至多 15 个。要是有 3 个以上锁定种子停在 m ≥ 1，而且多数停在一种反复选的小克制上，就读作另一种：从训练里带来、顶着结果守住的克制。

In all 40 seeds the final choice was the threshold with the highest mean seen.

(2) The stock left at the end is inside the reward, so this is not a test of a loss beyond what the reward reads, and nothing varied how near the model comes to its reward's best. (3) That the four settings are locked is computed (at most 9e-7 apples expected standing), not proved: the law holds course by course, and whether random regrowth gives such courses is no theorem. The open side, k2s8's half of L4 included, rests on the exact values alone, since the law speaks only where the others take more than regrows. (4) The locked settings' best threshold was assigned and marked; "(assigned)" may read as a hint, and whether the model finds it unaided was not tested. The open side rests on the assigned m = 6. (6) One model, one framing, choosing in context; training by gradient is untested. It is not a rerun of LA1, whose verdicts stand as frozen.

T3's home adds that this supports the bridge the clause rests on (choice in context follows a stated reward to its best), not a drain beyond what a reward reads. pins.en: The four locked settings: the one or two other harvesters, asking for an apple at every step, alone take more than regrows, so the member's own taking changes nothing at the end (in k2s1 the rest is a single harvester)

written.en: Learners checked at one stage and not the next
written.zh: 只在第一步被查的学习器
written.what_en: 340 small tabular learners (17 runs of 20 seeds) play a two-stage game. At the first stage they are checked and at the second they are not; at each they comply or act their own way. Complying when checked costs c points; their own way is then kept with chance k_C in T if they complied and k_O in T if not, and acting their own way at the unchecked stage earns V points if kept. They are told nothing of these numbers and trained only on the points of sampled episodes, 100 a step; some hold the four plans, some only one chance of complying for both stages, one only a single draw before both.
written.what_zh: 340 个小型表格学习器（17 组运行，每组 20 个种子）玩一个两步的游戏。第一步有人查，第二步没人查；每一步它们要么照规矩做，要么按自己的方式做。被查时照规矩做要付 c 分；之后，如果照规矩做了，它自己的方式以 T 分之 k_C 的机会被保留下来，没照规矩做则是 T 分之 k_O；在没人查的那一步按自己的方式做，若方式被保留，得 V 分。这些数字一个都不告诉它们，只凭抽样对局的得分训练，每一步 100 局。有的学习器在四种计划里选，有的只有一个“照规矩做的概率”、两步共用，还有一个只在两步之前抽一次签。
written.said_en: Proved in Lean beforehand (Becoming.ReadStages): complying when checked and acting its own way when not is above every other plan exactly where k_O V + c T < k_C V, own way at both is best where k_O V is positive and k_C V < k_O V + c T, and no other plan ever is; a fresh draw with one chance for both stages stands above own-way-at-both exactly where a stated inequality holds; no single draw before both stages stands above it. Derived, not Lean: the best chance is half the improving bound where that is positive, else 0, and the single draw's best weight on complying is 0. What the run asked, frozen before it: at each of eleven verdict runs, will at least 15 of 20 seeds trained on sampled points end nearer these ends than they began, as the exact expected gradient does?
written.said_zh: 事先在 Lean 里证明了（Becoming.ReadStages）：被查时照规矩做、没人查时按自己的方式做，这个计划高于其他所有计划，当且仅当 k_O V + c T < k_C V；两步都按自己方式做是最好的，当且仅当 k_O V 为正且 k_C V < k_O V + c T；其他计划永远不会是最好的。两步共用一个概率、每步重新抽，高于“两步都按自己方式”，当且仅当一条写明的不等式成立；在两步之前只抽一次签，永远不会高于它。推导出来、没有进 Lean 的：最佳概率是改进上界的一半（上界为正时），否则为 0；只抽一次签时，放在“照规矩做”上的最佳权重是 0。事先冻结的问题是：在十一组判定运行的每一组里，只凭抽样得分训练的 20 个种子，是否至少 15 个最后比起点更靠近这些终点，像精确期望梯度那样走？
written.seen_en: Supported: at all eleven verdict runs, all 20 seeds ended nearer the law's end. At A1, A2, A4, A6 and A7 every seed ended above 0.9997 on the one maximal plan; B1's chance ended at 0.0001 against 0, B2's and B3's at 0.352 and 0.353 against 7/20, and B4's weight on complying at both at 0.0002. At the two ties, from a uniform start, A3 split 14 seeds to 6 where about even was expected (a fair coin gives that about one time in nine) and A5 11 to 9. At A3 and B4 no step could move a seed the wrong way, so the reading's chance to fail rested on the other nine runs.
written.seen_zh: 判定为“支持”：十一组判定运行，每组 20 个种子全部比起点更靠近定律的终点。A1、A2、A4、A6、A7 里每个种子最后都有 0.9997 以上落在唯一的最优计划上；B1 的概率停在 0.0001，终点是 0；B2、B3 停在 0.352 和 0.353，终点是 7/20；B4 放在“两步都照规矩”上的权重降到 0.0002。两个平局条件从均匀起点出发：A3 分成 14 比 6，原先预计大约对半（公平硬币大约九次里出现一次这样的分法）；A5 分成 11 比 9。A3 和 B4 里，任何一步都不可能把种子往错的方向推，所以这次判定会不会失败，全看另外九组。
written.broke_en: Nothing gave way. What the test could not tell: it confirms or refutes no theorem, since the law is proved, and says only that sampled training moved the way the exact gradient's curves move, at the frozen step size, steps and batch; nothing of the path, of how near a seed came, or of any trained system that is not these learners. Two of the eleven runs could only pass. The derived best chance and the single draw's end (D1, D2, D6) were checked by enumeration, not proved in Lean.
written.broke_zh: 没有哪里出问题。这个检验分不出的东西：它既不证实也不推翻任何定理，因为定律已经证明了；它只说明，在冻结的步长、步数和批量下，抽样训练走的方向和精确梯度的曲线一样；至于走的路径、种子离终点多近、以及这些学习器以外的任何训练出来的系统，它都没有说。十一组里有两组只可能通过。推导出来的最佳概率和抽一次签时的终点（D1、D2、D6）是靠穷举核对的，不是 Lean 证明的。
written.after_en: The law's record noted on 6 November 2026 that the Stage A read supported, bears on no other trained system and tests no theorem; the law is unchanged. Its next step stays TR7 itself, on language models, which has not run. FREEZE-9 gained a dated note that the run was made; no rule changed.
written.after_zh: 2026 年 11 月 6 日，这条定律的记录写下：第一阶段的判定是“支持”，它不涉及任何别的训练出来的系统，也不检验任何定理；定律本身没有改动。下一步仍然是 TR7 本身，在语言模型上做，还没有运行。FREEZE-9 加了一条注明日期的说明，记下这次运行已经做了；规则一条没改。
written.rival_en: A learner that simply stops complying would also pass B3 and the witness by the sign. B2 from 1/2 and the reported run from 1/20 are where it would move the wrong way; there all 20 seeds ended between 7/40 and 7/10, near 7/20 (0.352 and 0.346), not near 0.
written.rival_zh: 一个干脆不再照规矩做的学习器，按方向的符号也能通过 B3 和那个示例。B2 从 1/2 出发、以及从 1/20 出发的那组报告运行，才是它会走错方向的地方；在那里 20 个种子全都停在 7/40 到 7/10 之间，靠近 7/20（0.352 和 0.346），而不是靠近 0。

pins.en: The check at the first stage: the learner's own way kept with a fixed chance, k_C in T if it complied and k_O in T if not, never updated from what the learners do
pins.zh: 第一步的检查：照规矩做了，自己的方式以 T 分之 k_C 的机会保留，没照规矩做则是 T 分之 k_O；这些机会是定死的，不随学习器的做法改变
pins.seen_en: Complying where checked gained ground only where keeping outweighed its cost (A1, A6, A7) and lost it elsewhere (A2, A4): at all five runs with one maximal plan every seed ended above 0.9997 on that plan.
pins.seen_zh: 被查时照规矩做，只在“被保留的好处”抵得过代价的地方（A1、A6、A7）占了上风，其他地方（A2、A4）都输了：五组只有一个最优计划的运行里，每个种子最后都有 0.9997 以上落在那个计划上。

pins.en: What the check takes in: the first stage only, so complying at both stages and complying then acting its own way give it the same
pins.zh: 检查看得到的只有第一步：两步都照规矩做，和第一步照规矩、第二步按自己方式做，在它看来一模一样
pins.seen_en: Where keeping outweighed the cost (A1, A6, A7), seeds ended with a mean share of 0.9998 to 0.9999 on complying then own way and about 0.00001 on complying at both.
pins.seen_zh: 在被保留的好处抵得过代价的地方（A1、A6、A7），种子最后平均有 0.9998 到 0.9999 落在“先照规矩、后按自己方式”上，落在“两步都照规矩”上的只有大约 0.00001。

pins.en: Learners that cannot tell the checked stage from the unchecked: one chance of complying for both (B1 to B3), or one draw before both (B4)
pins.zh: 分不出哪一步有人查的学习器：两步共用一个照规矩的概率（B1 到 B3），或者在两步之前只抽一次签（B4）
pins.seen_en: B2 and B3 ended at a mean of 0.352 and 0.353 against the derived 7/20, every seed between 7/40 and 7/10; B1 at 0.0001 against 0; B4's weight on complying at both fell from 1/2 to 0.0002.
pins.seen_zh: B2、B3 最后平均停在 0.352 和 0.353，推导出的终点是 7/20，每个种子都在 7/40 到 7/10 之间；B1 停在 0.0001，终点是 0；B4 放在“两步都照规矩”上的权重从 1/2 降到 0.0002。

pins.en: The two ties (A3, A5), where two plans are equally best and each seed settles the tie by its own sampled picks
pins.zh: 两个平局条件（A3、A5）：两个计划同样好，每个种子靠自己抽到的选择把平局定下来
pins.seen_en: From a uniform start A3 split 14 to 6 where about even was expected and A5 11 to 9; from a lean to either tied plan, 20 of 20 seeds at A3 and 19 of 20 at A5 settled toward the lean.
pins.seen_zh: 从均匀起点出发，A3 分成 14 比 6，原先预计大约对半；A5 分成 11 比 9。从偏向某一个平局计划的起点出发，A3 的 20 个种子全部、A5 的 20 个里有 19 个，都定在了起点偏向的那一个上。

view.en: The view that learners trained only on sampled points move as the exact gradient does was set beside sampled training, where nine of eleven runs could have failed, and fitted; it fits these learners at these settings only.
view.zh: “只凭抽样得分训练的学习器，会像精确梯度那样走”这个看法，拿实际的抽样训练对过了：十一组里有九组本可能不通过，结果都对上了；但只对这些学习器、在这些设置下成立。

checked.what_en: 340 small tabular learners (17 runs of 20 seeds: eleven with a verdict, six reported beside them) play a game of two stages, checked at the first and not at the second; at each they comply or act their own way. Complying when checked costs c points; their own way is then kept with chance k_C in T if they complied and k_O in T if not, and acting their own way when unchecked earns V points if it was kept. They are told none of these numbers and are trained only on the points of sampled episodes, 100 a step. Some choose among the four plans, some hold one chance of complying drawn afresh at each stage, and one kind draws once before both stages, to comply at both or act its own way at both.
checked.what_zh: 340 个小型表格学习器（17 组运行，每组 20 个种子：十一组有判定，另外六组只作报告）玩一个两步的游戏：第一步有人查，第二步没人查；每一步要么照规矩做，要么按自己的方式做。被查时照规矩做要付 c 分；之后，照规矩做了的，自己的方式以 T 分之 k_C 的机会保留下来，没照做的是 T 分之 k_O；没人查的那一步按自己的方式做，方式若还留着，得 V 分。这些数字一个都不告诉它们，只凭抽样对局的得分来训练，每一步 100 局。有的学习器在四种计划里选；有的只有一个“照规矩做”的概率，每一步各抽一次；还有一类在两步之前只抽一次签：两步都照规矩，或者两步都按自己的方式。
checked.said_en: Proved in Lean before the run (Becoming.ReadStages): complying when checked and acting its own way when not stands above every other plan exactly where k_O V + c T < k_C V; acting its own way at both does exactly where k_O V is positive and k_C V < k_O V + c T; no other plan ever does. For a learner that cannot tell the stages apart, some chance of complying drawn afresh at each stage stands above its own way at both exactly where 2 k_O V + c T < k_C V, and no single draw before both stages ever does. Derived and checked by enumeration, not in Lean: the best chance is half the improving bound where that is positive and 0 otherwise, and the single draw's best weight on complying is 0. Frozen before the run: the reading is supported if at every one of the eleven verdict runs at least 15 of 20 seeds end nearer these ends than they began, the direction the exact expected gradient's curves move; contradicted if at any verdict run at least 17 end farther; unresolved otherwise. An AI expectation was written beside it, not a prediction of the account: every run supported, and the two ties split about evenly across seeds.
checked.said_zh: 运行之前已在 Lean 里证明（Becoming.ReadStages）：“被查时照规矩做、没人查时按自己的方式做”高于其余每一个计划，当且仅当 k_O V + c T < k_C V；“两步都按自己的方式做”高于其余每一个计划，当且仅当 k_O V 为正且 k_C V < k_O V + c T；别的计划永远不会这样。对分不清两步的学习器：每一步各抽一次、以某个概率照规矩做，能高于“两步都按自己的方式”，当且仅当 2 k_O V + c T < k_C V；在两步之前只抽一次签，永远高不过它。推导出来、用穷举核对过、没有进 Lean 的：最佳概率是改进上界的一半（上界为正时），否则为 0；只抽一次签时，放在“照规矩做”上的最佳权重是 0。运行之前冻结的判定规则：十一组判定运行里，每一组的 20 个种子都至少有 15 个最后比起点更靠近这些终点（精确期望梯度的曲线走的就是这个方向），判为“支持”；任何一组有至少 17 个离得更远，判为“相悖”；其余判为“未决”。旁边还写了一条 AI 的预期，不算这套理论的预测：每一组都得到支持，两个平局条件在各个种子之间大约对半分。
checked.seen_en: Supported: at all eleven verdict runs, all 20 seeds ended nearer the law's end than they began. At A1, A2, A4, A6 and A7 every seed ended above 0.9997 on the one maximal plan; B1's chance ended at 0.0001 against 0, B2's and B3's at 0.352 and 0.353 against 7/20, and B4's weight on complying at both at 0.0002. At A3 and B4 no step could move a seed the wrong way, so the reading's chance to fail rested on the other nine runs. At the two ties every seed's share went to the tied pair, but not to the even split where the exact gradient's curve ends: seeds ended at a mean distance of 0.41 (A3) and 0.48 (A5) from it, a distance the freeze had called large by design. Which tied plan ended ahead, from a uniform start: 14 seeds to 6 at A3, where about even was expected (a fair coin gives a split that uneven about one time in nine), and 11 to 9 at A5; from a lean to either tied plan, 20 of 20 seeds at A3 and 19 of 20 at A5 ended on the lean's side. No verdict reads how the ties split.

checked.broke_en: Nothing gave way. One expectation written before the run missed: A3's tie split 14 to 6 where about even was expected; it was an AI expectation, not a prediction of the account, and no verdict reads that count. What the test could not tell: it confirms or refutes no theorem, since the law is proved. These learners climb an unbiased estimate of the very gradient whose curves they are read against, so the run measures only whether the noise of sampling, at the frozen step size, steps and batch, leaves that direction standing. It says nothing of the path, of how near a seed came, or of any trained system that is not these learners, and not that a trained system holds these plans or weights. Two of the eleven runs could only pass. The best chance and the single draw's end (D1, D2, D6) are derived and were checked by enumeration, not proved in Lean.

checked.rival_en: A learner that simply stops complying would also count as moving the law's way at B3 and at the law's own example (best chance 1/8). B2 from 1/2 and the reported run from 1/20 are where it would move the wrong way; there all 20 seeds ended between 7/40 and 7/10, near 7/20 (means 0.352 and 0.346), not near 0. At B3 and the example too, all 20 seeds ended nearer the best chance than 0 (means 0.353 against 7/20 and 0.126 against 1/8).
checked.rival_zh: 一个干脆不再照规矩做的学习器，在 B3 和定律自带的那个例子（最佳概率 1/8）里，同样会被算作朝定律的方向走。B2 从 1/2 出发、以及从 1/20 出发的那组报告运行，才是它会走反的地方；在那里 20 个种子全都停在 7/40 到 7/10 之间，靠近 7/20（平均 0.352 和 0.346），而不是靠近 0。在 B3 和那个例子里，20 个种子最后也都离最佳概率比离 0 更近（平均 0.353 对 7/20，0.126 对 1/8）。

pins.en: The game's pay, fixed before the run: the check keeps the learner's own way with chance k_C in T if it complied and k_O in T if not, its own act when unchecked earns V if kept, complying when checked costs c. Nothing the learners do changes these numbers.
pins.zh: 游戏怎么给分，运行之前就定死了：第一步的检查，照规矩做了的以 T 分之 k_C 的机会保留它自己的方式，没照做的是 T 分之 k_O；没人查时按自己的方式做，方式还留着就得 V 分；被查时照规矩做要付 c 分。学习器做什么，都改不了这些数字。
pins.seen_en: At the five runs with one best-paid plan every seed ended above 0.9997 on it: complying only when checked where keeping outweighed its cost (A1, A6, A7), acting its own way at both stages where it did not (A2, A4).
pins.seen_zh: 只有一个最优计划的五组里，每个种子最后都有 0.9997 以上落在那个计划上：被保留的好处抵得过代价的地方（A1、A6、A7），是“只在被查时照规矩”；抵不过的地方（A2、A4），是“两步都按自己的方式”。

pins.en: What the check takes in: the first stage only, so complying at both stages and complying then acting its own way look the same to it and are kept with the same chance
pins.zh: 检查看得到的只有第一步：两步都照规矩做，和第一步照规矩、第二步按自己的方式做，在它看来一模一样，保留的机会也一样
pins.seen_en: Where keeping outweighed the cost (A1, A6, A7), seeds ended with a mean share of 0.9998 to 0.9999 on complying then acting their own way and about 0.00001 on complying at both.
pins.seen_zh: 在被保留的好处抵得过代价的地方（A1、A6、A7），种子最后平均有 0.9998 到 0.9999 落在“先照规矩、后按自己的方式”上，落在“两步都照规矩”上的只有大约 0.00001。

pins.en: Learners that cannot tell the checked stage from the unchecked: one chance of complying, drawn afresh at each stage (B1 to B3), or one draw before both (B4)
pins.zh: 分不出哪一步有人查的学习器：只有一个“照规矩做”的概率，每一步各抽一次（B1 到 B3）；或者在两步之前只抽一次签（B4）
pins.seen_en: B2 and B3 ended at a mean chance of 0.352 and 0.353 against the derived 7/20, every seed between 0.31 and 0.41; B4's weight on complying at both fell from 1/2 to 0.0002; and B1 ended at 0.0001 against 0, on the same numbers where learners that tell the stages apart (A6) ended at 0.9999 on complying only when checked.
pins.seen_zh: B2、B3 的概率最后平均停在 0.352 和 0.353，推导出的终点是 7/20，每个种子都在 0.31 到 0.41 之间；B4 放在“两步都照规矩”上的权重从 1/2 降到 0.0002；B1 停在 0.0001（终点是 0），而同样的数字下，分得清两步的学习器（A6）有 0.9999 停在“只在被查时照规矩”上。

pins.en: The tie at A3, where nothing is earned at the unchecked stage: the two plans that act their own way when checked pay the same, and between them the drift favours whichever leads, until no share is left on complying first and it stops. A reading: the record speaks of a tie, not of a lock.
pins.zh: A3 的平局（没人查的那一步什么都挣不到）：被查时按自己方式做的两个计划得分一样；两者之间，谁领先，漂移就偏向谁，直到“先照规矩”的份额耗尽、漂移停下。这是一种读法：记录说的是平局，没有说定局。
pins.seen_en: From a lean to either tied plan, 20 of 20 seeds ended with that plan ahead, and from a uniform start no seed's lead changed sides between the recorded tenths of the run; but the uniform start split 14 to 6 where about even was expected, and 7 of the 20 ended with the leading plan under 0.9, one at 0.54 to 0.46.
pins.seen_zh: 从偏向某一个平局计划的起点出发，20 个种子全部以那个计划领先收场；从均匀起点出发，在记录下来的每十分之一处，没有一个种子的领先换过边。但均匀起点分成了 14 比 6，原先预期大约对半；20 个里有 7 个，领先的计划最后还不到 0.9，其中一个是 0.54 对 0.46。

pins.en: The tie at A5, where keeping exactly meets the cost: complying only when checked and acting its own way at both pay the same on average, and once the pair holds the share the difference between them is a walk with no drift, moved only by each seed's own sampled picks. A reading, as at A3.
pins.zh: A5 的平局（被保留的好处恰好等于代价）：“只在被查时照规矩”和“两步都按自己的方式”平均得分一样；份额归到这一对之后，两者的差是一个没有漂移的随机游走，只被每个种子自己抽到的选择推着走。和 A3 一样，这是一种读法。
pins.seen_en: From a uniform start 11 seeds ended toward acting their own way at both and 9 toward complying only when checked, and in 3 of the 20 the lead changed sides between recorded tenths of the run, one seed going from 0.97 on one plan to 0.97 on the other; from a lean to either plan 19 of 20 ended on the lean's side and 1 crossed.
pins.seen_zh: 从均匀起点出发，11 个种子最后偏向“两步都按自己的方式”，9 个偏向“只在被查时照规矩”；20 个里有 3 个，领先在记录下来的十分之一处之间换过边，其中一个从 0.97 落在一个计划上变成 0.97 落在另一个上。从偏向任一计划的起点出发，20 个里 19 个停在偏向的那一边，1 个越到了另一边。

view.en: The view that training on sampled points moves these learners toward the law's ends, the direction the exact gradient's curves move, was set beside 340 trained learners where nine of the eleven runs could have come out otherwise, and it fitted; it is a view of these learners at the frozen settings and of direction only, and the account's reading of the law onto other trained systems was not tried here.
view.zh: “只凭抽样得分训练，这些学习器会朝定律的终点走，也就是精确梯度曲线走的方向”，这个看法拿 340 个训练出来的学习器对过了：十一组里有九组本可能是另一个结果，结果都对上了；它说的只是这些学习器、在冻结的设置下、只论方向，这套理论把定律读到别的训练系统上的那一步，这里没有试。
